title: Pentaho Developer - ML Speciality
description: Machine learning with Pentaho Data Integration. A credit-card fraud-detection use case covering H2O AutoML, supervised and unsupervised learning, and handling imbalanced datasets.

moduleSummaries.title: Machine Learning
moduleSummaries.summary: Detect credit-card fraud with PDI: discover models automatically with H2O AutoML, learn fraud patterns with supervised algorithms, surface novel fraud with unsupervised methods, and handle the imbalanced datasets that make fraud detection hard.
